source.pdfs: PD-extraction/references/pdfs (publisher PDFs, not redistributed; crops stay in data/large/orchid_real/)

rule.record: table record, extraction_accepted, reader_agreement multi_reader, claude-opus-5.5 in readers, a printed numeric value
rule.table: paper + page + label, >= 4 such records, local PDF found
rule.sample: 400 tables, <= 3 per paper, stratified by record_kind / property_group (floor 15), seed 0
rule.split: sampled papers shuffled and halved: train / test
rule.page: locator.page is the 1-based PDF page (PyMuPDF index = page - 1)

text_layer_share.note: share of labelled values present as a number token in the PDF text layer of the cropped region, sign ignored; all_signed applies the scoring rule unchanged (many text layers encode the minus as a control character)
